bootstrap.block_definition: one randomized condition order per repetition; resample complete repetition blocks
bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive interval for median-based D; not a formal significance test

fixture_metrics.association_metric: Cramer's V computed from the exact categorical contingency table; pair_distinct is the number of distinct observed value pairs

interpretation_policy.additivity_error_detectability: D(M)=sum singleton medians - T(M) - (k-1)T(empty), with block bootstrap over all contributing conditions
interpretation_policy.central_estimate: median of timed runs per condition
interpretation_policy.increment_detectability: abs(C(M)) compared with twice the quadrature MAD of current and empty conditions; descriptive only
interpretation_policy.payload_validation: unique timed cells, expected statistic names/targets, positive unique OIDs, and non-null MCV payloads are required
interpretation_policy.realized_sample_rows: not observed; requested target is source-derived only
interpretation_policy.relative_error: reported only when the observed increment exceeds the descriptive increment-noise screen; otherwise marked inconclusive
interpretation_policy.spread: IQR and MAD retained per condition

timing_method.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC via instr_time on the measured platform
timing_method.scope: server command round-trip; persistent connection; excludes DDL/setup and connection establishment
